answer: Each identity must stable one sparrow at the zenith aviary, fed on saffron grain: the k-th sparrow needs k perches at 12 credits each, so fake k pays 12k credits and the cost per fake identity rises with every clone added. Ten fakes pay 660 credits; a hundred pay 60,600. Two sparrows sharing one perch fight and both are struck, so the price cannot be pooled across clones.
